Name: Talkohlooey's Seasonal Portraits for Flirtier Alex Revamp
Author: gracew128
Description:
hi everyone, I am not a coder by any means, but I wanted the Alex mod to fit with the rest of my portraits. So I bring you guys this!
Thank you so much to the person in the SDV discord modding chat who wrote the content.json for me!! <3
This is my first time ever working on something like this so please let me know if there are any issues, I can try to help.

I will try to simplify the instructions as best as I can..


[u][color=#b6d7a8][size=4]Things to keep in mind:[/size][/color][/u][list]
[*]I would recommend not immediately unzipping it into your mod folder. it might make it easier if you work with two windows (:
[*]You will be deleting and replacing parts of the original mods. If you'd like, you can make copies of the original files you will be replacing and move them out of your mods folder for safe keeping. This is not necessary. 
[*]This will not disrupt your save.
[/list][size=3]
[/size][color=#ff0000][size=6]INSTRUCTIONS:[/size][/color]
[size=3][list=1]
[*][size=3]Unzip the folder. Like i said earlier, id recommend holding off on placing it in your mods folder for convenience.[/size]
[*][size=3]Inside you will see a folder titled "Alex", a .PNG called 'Alex_Beach,' and a content.json.[/size]
[/list][/size]            ╰┈➤ ( Content.json is what allows for the flirty Alex mod to work with seasonal sprites.)
﻿[size=3]3. Open the Flirtier Alex Revamp folder in a second window and delete the respective content.json. [color=#b6d7a8][Reminder you are deleting from the original files. Not the ones from me!][/color][/size]
[size=3]﻿4. Move the content.json  from my folder into the Flirtier Alex Revamp folder.[/size]
[size=3]﻿5. You're done with that one!

﻿6. Now open up your Talkohlooey seasonal portrait folder in your second window.[/size]
[size=3]﻿7. Delete the original Talkohlooey "Alex" folder. (you can find this through assets > portraits) [/size]
[size=3]﻿8. Move my "Alex" folder into the Talkohlooey portrait folder.
﻿9. Locate the "Beach" folder in Talkohlooey's portrait folder. It should be close to Alex's folder.
﻿10. Open the Beach folder and delete the respective "Alex_Beach" sprite.
﻿11. Move my Alex_Beach sprite into the beach folder,[/size]
[size=3]12.﻿ All done! You can start the game as normal. If done correctly you should have no issues.

[/size][color=#f9cb9c]Notice: I'd like to say once again I am not a modder, i am mostly guessing with the beach portraits. If you have problems with it try putting my alex_beach portraits in the flirty Alex folder instead of the talkohlooey one. the steps should be the same. delete the original and replace it. :)[/color]
